headline: Clariant and CD&R in Talks to Acquire Specialty Chemical Maker Ashland
summary: Swiss specialty chemicals producer Clariant and private equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice are in discussions to acquire US-based chemical company Ashland, according to Bloomberg reports.
why: Ashland is a major US specialty chemicals company; corporate buyouts in the sector alter market consolidation and supply chain dynamics.
